selective_hmmer_measurement_backend.validation: Biopython Stockholm/FASTA writers and per-row HMMER SearchIO parsers; each repeated model/target identity and length checked, with successful completion/footer/version, unique targets, raw/parsed row counts, finite full-sequence/domain values, observed/reported/included counts, domain indices/totals and half-open alignment/envelope coordinates. selective_hmmer_measurement_backend.native_unknown_limitation: The existing native center-star alignment can represent encoded unknown residues as gaps, including an all-unknown source becoming an all-gap row. The backend preserves and reports that existing source representation, verifies all known residues remain unchanged, and compares HMMER's annotated alignment to the actual native alignment rather than falsely blaming HMMER for the prior conversion. Calibration FASTA retains original native-encoded unknowns; an unreported source makes calibration explicitly incomplete. This is not an unknown-residue handling fix and no scoring parameter was retuned.
